## Progress

- [Nakayama.lean](/home/axel/LeanAlgebraicGeometry-Horizon/FormalizedSources/StacksProject/Part01_Preliminaries/StacksPart01Lib/Nakayama.lean:23): added 15 declarations covering all twelve clauses of Stacks Tag 00DV, including localized surjectivity, generator lifting, and nilpotent forms.
- [Basic.lean](/home/axel/LeanAlgebraicGeometry-Horizon/FormalizedSources/StacksProject/Part01_Preliminaries/StacksPart01Lib/Basic.lean:47): exports the new API.
- Code commits: `b8b3f5f5e0`, `2f0221750a`, `62a2ff2ed8`, `29323f31c7`, `fec9d8162c`, `b2d2d9e148`.
- Hgraph synced to 5,819 nodes, including 318 checked Lean declarations, 5,388 edges, and zero stale nodes. Updated the [00DV producer note](/home/axel/LeanAlgebraicGeometry-Horizon/FormalizedSources/StacksProject/Part01_Preliminaries/hgraph/nodes/e0eee3f7f7fd/comment-3.md) and [051B frontier note](/home/axel/LeanAlgebraicGeometry-Horizon/FormalizedSources/StacksProject/Part01_Preliminaries/hgraph/nodes/214caebb38fc/comment-3.md).
- Roadmap and I-2051 now record complete 00DV producer coverage; final metadata commit is `5abe79534f`. No blueprint source was modified.

## Issues

- The frozen 00DV TeX node remains empty and unattached under I-2034/I-2051. The generated Lean nodes have no substantive consumer edges, so this is producer coverage, not source-node completion.
- Tag 051B, finite-presentation support closedness with quasi-compact complement, remains open.
- Graph sync retains one pre-existing missing blueprint dependency and 318 expected unattached declarations.
- An earlier broad Horizon check waited out on the shared resource slot. The final serialized Nakayama check subsequently passed.
- Janitor found no Part01 cleanup requirement. Global task, roadmap, and inbox collection-size warnings remain outside this project’s scope.

## Why I Stopped

The standing objective is partly advanced, with the complete Tag 00DV producer unit committed and verified. The task intentionally remains `running`; the next work is the distinct and larger Tag 051B consumer.

## Next

Formalize Tag 051B using a finite free presentation, the existing maximal-minor API, the 00DV localization criterion, and a finite standard-open cover of the support complement. Add source attachments only through an authorized traceability pass.

## Epistemic Checkpoint

- Claim class: proved producer with an imported Mathlib boundary.
- Frontier before/after: Tag 00DV had no packaged source-wide API; it now has checked declarations for clauses (1) through (12). Its TeX node remains empty; Tag 051B is next.
- Consumer: intended Tag 051B node `214caebb38fc`; no substantive Lean consumer yet.
- Evidence: `lake build StacksPart01Lib` passed all 2,519 jobs; final Horizon file check and LSP diagnostics passed; all 15 declaration scans use only `propext`, `Classical.choice`, and `Quot.sound`, with no `sorry`, `admit`, or project axioms.
- `honesty-reviewer: used`, verdict honest but partial. Clause (7)’s set formulation is a faithful strengthening of the finite-list statement; source completion and downstream integration are explicitly not claimed.
